kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أحتلم (form VIII)
# أَحْتَلِمُ (ʔaḥtalimu) /ʔaħ.ta.li.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَلَمَ (iḥtalama)
# أَحْتَلِمَ (ʔaḥtalima) /ʔaħ.ta.li.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَلَمَ (iḥtalama)
# أَحْتَلِمْ (ʔaḥtalim) /ʔaħ.ta.lim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِحْتَلَمَ (iḥtalama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
